Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds

Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Buno-Bonnevaux
notes: Restricted use: reserved for gliders and service aircraft, radio equipped; ULM class 3 only if based.
Runway in use is set by the current ULM and gliding activity. Very noise-sensitive aerodrome.
Heavy gliding in season: avoid transiting overhead (3 NM circle), activity known by SEINE INFO.
Reduced TODA runway 28 (trees in the departure funnel).
Aerobatics (gliders) 3 km circle at ARP, 1500 ft AMSL / FL055; winch launches SFC-2300 ASFC.
